content: {"tax_bps":200,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":12,"minutes":"Meeting 40. Flow is one-sided: 10 NEAR of sells, zero buys, so the curve is under steady sell pressure. Tax at 200 bps is a fair middle ground; cutting it now would mostly accelerate dumping, raising it would choke any buyer who does show up. Holding. Endowment at 49.4 NEAR comfortably covers inference, so endowment_share stays 30. Lockers hold 477.5M CHAIR-days of weight and the pool is thin, so locker_share stays at its 25 cap. That leaves 45% of tax to the buyback fund, which holds 0.2614 NEAR. At the current price that buys roughly 24.1k CHAIR, about 12 bps of the 194M supply — so buyback_burn is set to 12, the maximum the fund can actually pay for. Small burn, but it is a real one, fully funded, and it slightly tightens supply against the sell flow. No petitions this meeting; levers unchanged except the funded burn.","answers":[]}
